tasks.title: Draft review phase stability plan + tasks
tasks.goal: Document the plan and tasks needed to stabilize review phase output and guardrails.
acceptance_criteria: Plan references the spec and follows the plan template.
Tasks JSON validates against autonomy-tasks schema.
Risks and evidence checklist are documented.
tasks.notes: Keep scope limited to review-phase stability.

tasks.title: Stream codex stdout/stderr to artifacts
tasks.goal: Persist live stdout/stderr for review phase to avoid silent failures.
acceptance_criteria: Review runs emit review-stdout.txt and/or review-stderr.txt during execution.
Artifacts remain even if codex exec exits early.
tasks.observability: Structured logs include phase output capture events.
tasks.notes: Use io.MultiWriter to avoid losing final output.

tasks.title: Add prompt size + snapshot size diagnostics
tasks.goal: Record prompt size and snapshot size to debug review stalls.
acceptance_criteria: Review phase writes an artifact with prompt size (bytes).
Snapshot size is logged or recorded alongside the prompt size.
tasks.observability: Prompt size is included in phase logs.

tasks.title: Add per-phase idle timeouts + review guardrail
tasks.goal: Allow review longer execution with explicit guardrails for oversized prompts.
acceptance_criteria: Config supports review-specific idle timeout override.
Review prompt guardrail emits review-skipped.txt when exceeded.
Existing phases keep defaults if overrides are unset.
tasks.observability: Guardrail events log reason and prompt size.

tasks.title: Add tests for streaming + guardrails
tasks.goal: Ensure streaming artifacts and prompt guardrails are covered in tests.
acceptance_criteria: Tests validate streaming artifacts exist mid-flight.
Tests validate review guardrail skip behavior.

tasks.title: Run loop smoke test and capture evidence
tasks.goal: Verify review phase completes or skips with artifacts after fixes.
acceptance_criteria: Review artifacts exist and include prompt size diagnostics.
tasks.observability: Run logs and artifacts captured for evidence.
